ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping Districts; RS-3, Residential, Single-Unit, Detached House Districts;
and C1-2, Neighborhood Commercial Districts symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 18-C in the area bound by:

South Euclid Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to East 75" Street;
South Crandon Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to East 75" Street;
South Merill Avenue; a line 125 feet south of and parallel to East 75" Street;
South Clyde Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to East 75" Street,
South Merril Avenue; and East 75" Street,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District,

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Gregory k Mitchell
AldeFman, 7th Ward

Common Addresses:

1932-2258 E. 75" Street
